# Code Language Recognition

Automatically recognize SiYuan code block languages with a fast, offline local model.

## Features

* Recognizes paste content in language-less code blocks and language-less code blocks generated by pasting into paragraphs
* Uses betlang WASM for 46 common languages and local feature rules for long-tail languages
* Runs entirely on-device without uploading code or requiring network access
* Uses SiYuan editor transactions, so language changes can be undone
* Automatically processes only code blocks with an empty language and preserves every existing language
* Provides a command that recognizes the current code block or code blocks within mixed block selections
* Force-recognizes code blocks and descendant code blocks from mixed selections in the block menu
* Recognizes every regular code block in a document from the document title menu

## Usage

Paste source code into a language-less code block, or paste content that SiYuan converts into one or more language-less code blocks, and the plugin will recognize and set their languages in the background.

If automatic recognition does not run, place the caret in a code block or select blocks containing code blocks, then run “Recognize current or selected code block languages” from the command palette. Blocks remain unchanged when recognition confidence is insufficient.

## Settings

* Enable plugin
* Recognition on paste

Markdown uses the same confidence checks as other code-block languages.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run test
pnpm run build
```

Regenerating the WASM requires Rust 1.88 or later, the `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target, and the same `wasm-bindgen-cli` version as `wasm-detector/Cargo.toml`:

```sh
rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.105 --locked
pnpm run build:wasm
```

Generated files under `src/wasm/` are committed, so plugin users do not need Rust.

## Third-party components

Powered by [betlang](https://github.com/ealmloff/betlang) (MIT). The bundled model is distilled from the [Google Magika](https://github.com/google/magika) teacher model (Apache-2.0). Full license texts are included in `THIRD_PARTY-betlang-LICENSE` and `THIRD_PARTY-Magika-LICENSE`.
